notes: In Vietnamese, family terms change based on relative age and maternal/paternal lineage. 'Bác' is specifically used for the older siblings of your parents, regardless of their gender.
Do not confuse 'bác' with 'chú' (father's younger brother) or 'cô' (father's younger sister).
You can also use 'bác' to address any person who is roughly the age of your parents, even if they are not related to you.
